en.title: Global Macro — The inflation test after resilient US hiring: markets enter a data gap, not a new trading day
en.deck: Weekend analytical edition: October US payrolls rose by 165,000, while third-quarter productivity increased 3.6% annualised and unit labour costs fell 0.7%; the October CPI remains scheduled, not observed.
en.regime: Resilient US hiring coexists with strong quarterly productivity, mixed unit-labour-cost signals and unresolved October inflation; monetary and external-financing conditions remain differentiated.
en.key_risk: Treating a scheduled CPI release as observed, equating nominal wages with unit labour costs, or mixing market closes and later data vintages.

pt-BR.title: Global Macro — O teste inflacionário após o emprego resistente nos EUA: os mercados entram em uma janela de dados, não em um novo pregão
pt-BR.deck: Edição dominical: emprego americano cresceu 165 mil postos em outubro; produtividade avançou 3,6% anualizados no terceiro trimestre e o custo unitário do trabalho caiu 0,7%; o CPI de outubro segue agendado, ainda não divulgado.
pt-BR.regime: Emprego americano resistente convive com produtividade trimestral forte, sinais mistos de custo unitário do trabalho e inflação de outubro ainda não divulgada; condições monetárias e de financiamento externo permanecem distintas.
pt-BR.key_risk: Tratar CPI agendado como divulgado, equiparar salário nominal a custo unitário do trabalho ou misturar fechamentos de mercado com versões posteriores dos dados.

revision_reason: Revision 2 resolves the open QA rejection: expands the bilingual analysis beyond the 1,700-word daily floor, adds six-plus analytical H2 sections, adds a second sourced chart and three evidence tables, and replaces internal-only support with independently traceable primary institutional and market sources. The 05:00 BRT cutoff and the original thesis are preserved; no post-cutoff observation is introduced.
revision_scope: Expand the labour analysis with the 6 November BLS payroll release and the 5 November preliminary Q3 productivity and unit-labour-cost release.
Add a second quantitative chart for BLS Q3 productivity and unit labour costs, with identical numeric series in EN and PT-BR.
Add central-bank policy comparison using the 28 October Federal Reserve statement, 29 October ECB decision and 4 November Copom statement.
Add official China October PMI detail, US high-yield OAS as of 5 November, ECB reference FX rates as of 6 November, IIF October EM portfolio-flow estimate and FAO October food-price index.
Expand both editions beyond 1,700 substantive words, with at least six analytical H2 sections, three tables, two charts, one flow and one regional map.
Replace internal-only market references with 14 external source entries; all observations remain within the 8 November 05:00 BRT information cutoff.

producer_checks.novelty_decision: Retains the original next-policy-test thesis while adding a distinct productivity/unit-labour-cost counter-signal and differentiated central-bank, credit, capital-flow and food/energy transmission. Does not repeat the preceding industrial-activity, AI-equity repricing or payroll-only editions.

source_audit.cutoff_audit: All selected observations and releases were available by 2026-11-08 05:00 BRT. The 6 November BLS employment release, BLS productivity release, Treasury curve, ECB reference rates and Reuters market close predate the cutoff; FRED credit observation is limited to 5 November; no 6 November FRED update or later release is used.
